newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-JUANELE SCORES TWICE TO BRING TENERIFE IN NEXT ROUND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUANELE SCORES TWICE TO BRING TENERIFE IN NEXT ROUND.

text.p: Tenerife striker Juanele scored twice to help the little club from the Canary Islands score an upset 4-2 away win over former European Cup holders Feyenoord on Tuesday and earn a place in the quarter-finals of the UEFA Cup for the first time in their history.

Tenerife, who held the powerful Dutch club to a goalless draw in the home leg of their third round tie, hit Feyenoord with four goals in Rotterdam before their opponents pulled two back in the last 10 minutes.
Midfielder Felipe opened the scoring in the fifth minute, shooting into an empty net after Feyenoord goalkeeper Ed de Goey misjudged what had appeared to be a harmless cross.
Juanele made it 2-0 in the last minute of the first half when his ferocious shot was deflected past de Goey and then added his second on the hour, leaving the goalkeeper no chance.
In the 74th minute Argentine defender Pablo Paz, who had just replaced skipper Felipe, punished a defensive error when he headed home a cross to make it 4-0.
Feyenoord, second in the Dutch first division, worked hard but failed to make an impression. Their passing was bad and they had trouble keeping the ball in possession.
Tenerife, only 13nd in the Spanish league, might have won by an even bigger margin but failed to convert several chances they created on the break.
Eight minutes from time Argentine Pablo Sanchez pulled one back for Feyenoord and five minutes later Henk Vos reduced the arrears to 4-2. But it was all too late to save the Dutch.
